Epoch schedule sysvar constants and functions for slot-to-epoch calculations.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_sysvar_epoch_schedule` interface for Solana epoch scheduling in the runtime. It documents the epoch model, including warmup epochs, constant-length epochs, and the slot boundaries that determine when an epoch changes. The file also declares constants such as `FD_EPOCH_LEN_MIN` and `FD_EPOCH_LEN_MAX`, which set the allowed range for epoch length calculations and prevent overflow in related math. Its function declarations support sysvar account initialization, read and write access, schedule derivation, and conversion between slot numbers and epoch numbers, which makes it a core metadata interface for epoch-related runtime logic.
